verdict.rationale: Temporal's AI docs explicitly describe first-party wrapping of an AI stack: the OpenAI Agents SDK integration executes model calls as Activities so they retry durably and survive Worker restarts without extra glue code (temporal-docs-25), and there's a durable-agentic-loop cookbook for Claude tool calling (temporal-docs-33) plus a dedicated AI landing page framing long-running agent loops (temporal-docs-9). This is real but narrow — it only names one agent framework (OpenAI Agents SDK) and one model provider (Claude) rather than a broad catalog of AI SDKs/frameworks/providers, and there's no independent/community corroboration of these specific integrations working smoothly. Missing for 10: first-party integrations for additional agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) and model providers, plus independent/hands-on validation of the OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude integrations.
